        "id": "F10",
        "title": "The retained model-grade contract cannot execute inside finalization",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:183",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:187",

        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "A-05 leaves the foundation model-grade input and guards incompatible with its new caller (amendment 183, 1100, 1178; foundation 3383, 3386, 3410, 3426, 3445). The request must be Open in the retained foundation contract, but finalization calls it while Finalizing. The old DTO still requires removed receipt paths and thread fields; its pre-write staleness dispatch expects no transaction, whereas the new call is inside one. Replace the complete internal grade contract, guards, side effects, and diagrams, including responsibility for completing the outer request. A-09 also names section 3.1 for a check actually in 6.3 (foundation 2842).",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F11",
        "title": "Response findings cannot satisfy or survive the result contract",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:498",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:551",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:562",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1285",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-015",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-021"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "The response finding wire shape (551) has only claimId, check, outcome, whereas V-8 (1285) requires category, location, evidence and remediation on every finding. HvFinding (498) has no response scope or response id, and the result's responseGrades omit findings (562) while its failures promise every FAIL and UNKNOWN (564). Define a lossless response finding contract and result projection, with negative tests for missing remediation and positive failing-grade persistence.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F12",
        "title": "A legitimate mid-review response closure invalidates the reviewer",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:182",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:544",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1280",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1285",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-021-AC003"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "ResponseStatusTransition may close a Pending response during review (182, 480; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-021-AC003), while the accepted request is immutable (544). V-3/V-8 bind against the current Pending set (1280, 1285). A reviewer legitimately grading the admitted response after it closes is rejected and taken Offline. Bind reviewer output to the accepted set and define how closed items are ignored at commit, with reject/supersede races covered.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F13",
        "title": "Overall verdict predicates contradict one another",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:173",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1281",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture.md:2840",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-010",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-021"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "V-4 makes overall AGREE an iff over holistic and turn verdicts, omitting response grades (1281), while importing the foundation verdict_match iff over response grades (foundation 2840). These rules disagree for mixed turn/response outcomes and R-31 forbids every FAIL/UNKNOWN (173). Define one overall predicate over all applicable verdicts and findings and propagate it to the foundation replacement and criteria.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
